ab_roller.description: The Spartan Dude gains 10% Max HP and 10% Deflection, and he Spawns near other Dudes.
ab_roller.name: Ab Roller

action.description: Action Dudes may get knocked down, but they always come back in the third act to save the world.
action.name: Action

agent.description: When he deals Direct Damage, he has a 15% chance to Dash to a Roster Dude in danger. Any Dude he Dashes to becomes an Asset for 8 seconds, gaining Temporary Health for 20% of his Max HP.
agent.name: Agent Dude

alien.description: Every 3 seconds, he Beams a random Dude of the Dude Type immediately above him on the Roster, forcing him to Dash to the enemy with the lowest HP and attack it.
alien.name: Alien Dude

ancient_sword.description: 2 Skeledudes are Summoned when battle starts. When a Dude Taunts, there is a 5% chance he pierces into the Underworld and Summons a Skeledude, with a 1 second Global Cooldown.
ancient_sword.name: Ancient Sword

assassin.description: His Direct Damage injects Toxins into his target, reducing its Attack Power by 5% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
assassin.name: Assassin Dude

assassin_song.description: The Ninja Dude gains 20% Evasion. When he uses Shuriken Throw, he gains an Independently Stacking 5% Attack Power for 3 seconds.
assassin_song.name: Mix Tape

attack_speed.description: How many times per second you Attack.
attack_speed.name: Attack Speed

bagpipes.description: The Knight Dude gains 10% Toughness, and he now has a 20% chance when dealing Direct Damage to Taunt a nearby enemy.
bagpipes.name: Bagpipes

bamboo_practice.description: The Samurai Dude gains 20% Deflection. When he Deflects, he gains 5% Crit Chance for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
bamboo_practice.name: Bamboo Dummy

bard.description: Every 4 times he deals Direct Damage, the Bard Dude plays a Song that inspires 4 random Dudes, granting 4% Attack Power and Run Speed for 4 seconds. This effect stacks up to 4 times.
bard.name: Bard Dude

basic.description: Gains 2% Attack Power and Max HP for every additional Regular Dude on your Roster.
basic.name: Regular Dude

bat_wings.description: When a Vampire Dude takes Fatal Damage, he Lifesteals from nearby enemies until his HP is full and then teleports away. 10 second Cooldown.
bat_wings.name: Bat Wings

bean_burrito.description: When a Dude gets Knocked Out, he creates a burst of toxic gas when he lands, dealing damage equal to 400% of his DPS to nearby enemies.
bean_burrito.name: Bean Burrito

belted_greaves.description: The Knight Dude gains 10% Toughness. In addition, all Dudes gain 1% Toughness per Knight Dude on your Team, stacking up to 10%.
belted_greaves.name: Belted Greaves

black_sheep.description: When battle starts, the Dude Type at the end of your Roster immediately Taunts up to 5 random enemies for 3 seconds.
black_sheep.name: Black Sheep

blacksmith_hammer.description: The Knight Dude gains 30% Max HP. When he lands a Direct Crit, he deals bonus damage equal to 40% of his current Temporary Health.
blacksmith_hammer.name: Blacksmith's Hammer

block_chance.description: The chance to Block incoming Direct Damage, preventing it. Block Chance is a Diminishing Stat.
block_chance.name: Block Chance

blood_bag.description: The Vampire Dude gains 50% Cleave, and any Dude who Lifesteals now also Heals the most-injured Roster Dude for 80% of the Lifesteal amount.
blood_bag.name: Blood Bag

blood_siphon.description: When the Vampire Dude takes damage while below 50% HP, he Siphons 20% HP from a random healthier Roster Dude and applies Bloodsucker Aura to him.
blood_siphon.name: Blood Siphon

bloody_talisman.description: When a Dude receives Healing, he gains 1% Attack Speed for the rest of the battle. This effect can stack up to 20 times.
bloody_talisman.name: Bloody Talisman

bone_axe.description: The Skeledude gains 100% Attack Power. When a Skeledude takes Fatal Damage, all nearby Dudes gain 10% Crit Chance for 6 seconds.
bone_axe.name: Bone Axe

bone_broth.description: The Frankendude's Blood Pump now additionally Heals the next 2 most-injured Roster Dudes for 30% of the HP Donated each.
bone_broth.name: Bone Broth

bonfire.description: Dudes gain 1% Max HP for every Dude of the same Family on your Team, up to a maximum of 20%.
bonfire.name: Bonfire

bony_backhand.description: The Skeledude gains 20% Toughness, and he Taunts up to 4 nearby enemies for 4 seconds when he gets Summoned.
bony_backhand.name: Bony Backhand

book_of_shadows.description: The Ninja Dude gains 50% Crit Damage, and his Shurikens now bounce to 1 additional enemy.
book_of_shadows.name: Book of Shadows

booming_voice.description: The General Dude commands Dudes to Taunt 2 more enemies at a time, and he deals damage around the Taunter equal to 300% of his DPS, split among enemies hit.
booming_voice.name: Megaphone

brain_in_a_jar.description: The Frankendude gains 4% Regeneration. When he Donates HP to a Dude through his Blood Pump, he also deals Direct Damage to a nearby enemy for 10% of his DPS.
brain_in_a_jar.name: Brain in a Jar

caboose.description: The Dude Type at the end of your Roster gains 30% Max HP.
caboose.name: Caboose

caged_tiger.description: When any Dude gets Knocked Out, all Dudes gain 20% Crit Chance for 3 seconds.
caged_tiger.name: Caged Tiger

calcium_pills.description: The Skeledude gains 60% Max HP, and the Necrodude gains 30% Max HP. When a Skeledude takes Fatal Damage, he Heals the 5 most-injured Roster Dudes for 100% of his Max HP, split evenly among them.
calcium_pills.name: Calcium Pills

captains_hat.description: The Dude Type at the top of your Roster gains 30% Attack Power.
captains_hat.name: Captain's Hat

cave.description: First, Cave Dude Unga. Then... he Bunga.
cave.name: Cave Dude

chef.description: When he deals Direct Damage, he prepares a Burger that Heals for 70% of his Attack Power. He can have 4 Burgers prepared at a time, and he delivers them to Roster Dudes as needed.
chef.name: Chef Dude

chestplate.description: When the Knight Dude takes damage greater than 5% of his Max HP, he gains Temporary Health for 3 seconds equal to 40% of the damage taken.
chestplate.name: Chestplate

cleave.description: A chance to hit an additional target near your Primary Target when you Attack. Every 100% Cleave is a guaranteed extra hit.
cleave.name: Cleave

cleave_reduction.description: Reduces the damage dealt by Cleave. Cleave Damage Down is a Diminishing Stat.
cleave_reduction.name: Cleave Damage Down

cleric.description: Every 2 seconds, the Cleric Dude creates a Pulse at the most-injured Roster Dude. The Pulse Heals injured Dudes within its radius for 100% of the Cleric Dude's DPS, split evenly among them.
cleric.name: Cleric Dude

clumpy_potion.description: Teleports a group of Dudes to a location of your choosing and grants them Temporary Health equal to 25% of their Max HP that lasts until depleted.
clumpy_potion.name: Burner Phone

combat_boots.description: The General Dude gains 20% Toughness and Attack Power.
combat_boots.name: Combat Boots

combat_radio.description: When a General Dude uses Tactical Command, the target Dude gains an Independently Stacking 15% Attack Power, 5% Crit Chance, and 30% Cleave for 4 seconds.
combat_radio.name: Combat Radio

cons_pocket_dice.description: Rerolls the Relics and Trinkets found in Stashes, rerolls Flyers, and restocks the inventory of the Merchant Dude.
cons_pocket_dice.name: Pocket Dice

construction.description: When he deals Direct Damage he has a 20% chance to toss a Hammer at a nearby enemy, damaging it for 50% of his Attack Power and Taunting it for 3 seconds.
construction.name: Construction Dude

copper_bolts.description: The Frankendude gains 30% Attack Speed. When he deals Direct Damage, he has a 20% chance to gain 1% Regeneration for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 times.
copper_bolts.name: Copper Bolts

crit_chance.description: The chance you land a Critical Hit, dealing increased damage. Crit Chance is a Diminishing Stat.
crit_chance.name: Crit Chance

crit_damage.description: Increases the damage of your Critical Hits.
crit_damage.name: Crit Damage

crit_weakness.description: Increases the damage you take from Critical Hits.
crit_weakness.name: Crit Vulnerability

crittable.description: Increases your chance to receive Critical Hits.
crittable.name: Crit Exposure

cyborg.description: When a Cyborg Dude deals Direct Damage to his Primary Target, he has a 25% chance to grant a stacking 1% Attack Power to all Cyborg Dudes for the rest of the battle.
cyborg.name: Cyborg Dude

damage.description: How much damage you deal with each Attack.
damage.name: Attack Power

death_mask.description: When a Medic Dude casts Triage on a Dude who is below 25% HP, that Dude gains 30% Attack Speed and 15% Toughness for 3 seconds.
death_mask.name: Death Mask

death_rattle.description: All Dudes gain 2% Attack Power during battle per Unconscious Dude on your Team, up to a maximum of 30%.
death_rattle.name: Death Rattle

deflection.description: A chance to Deflect incoming damage, taking no damage and instead redirecting 50% of the damage as Direct Damage to an ally with high current HP. Allies can Block or Evade damage that is redirected to them through Deflection. Deflection is a Diminishing Stat.
deflection.name: Deflection

dentist.description: When the Dentist Dude deals Direct Damage, he injects a random Dude with Novocaine for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack of Novocaine prevents 3% of incoming damage.
dentist.name: Dentist Dude

dog_tag.description: When a Dude gets Knocked Out, all Dudes gain 20% Run Speed for the rest of the battle. This effect can stack up to 50 times.
dog_tag.name: Dog Tag

dps.description: How much damage you deal per second while Attacking, determined by multiplying your Attack Speed and Attack Power.
dps.name: DPS

druid.description: After he lands 10 Direct Damage hits while in Dude Form, he shapeshifts into a Bear, gaining 30% Attack Power and 200% Cleave for 3 seconds.
druid.name: Druid Dude

dude_juice.description: Revives Unconscious Dudes! If used in the Ranch, revives 10 Dudes. If used during battle, revives 5 Dudes with full HP.
dude_juice.name: Dude Juice

dudeplicator.description: Immediately grants 2 Burner Phones and reduces their price by 50%. Dudes teleported by the Burner Phone gain 50% Attack Power, 50% Attack Speed, and 10% Crit Chance for 5 seconds.
dudeplicator.name: Splitting Headache

ectoplasm_vial.description: When the Ghost Dude casts Phase Shift, he grants Temporary Health to both target Dudes equal to 100% of his Attack Power for 3 seconds.
ectoplasm_vial.name: Ectoplasm Vial

electrician.description: When the Electrician Dude deals Direct Damage, he gains a Static Charge. At 10 Charges or more, his next Attack discharges a Static Shock, Throwing him and damaging his target for 40% Attack Power per Charge.
electrician.name: Electrician Dude

employed.description: Employed Dudes have the tools and the know-how to get the job done right the third time. First time if the pay is good.
employed.name: Employed

epinephrine.description: The Medic Dude's Triage grants 5% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. This effect can stack up to 4 times.
epinephrine.name: Epinephrine

evasion.description: The chance to Evade incoming damage, preventing it. Evasion is a Diminishing Stat.
evasion.name: Evasion

expired_skin_cream.description: When a Zombie Dude receives Healing, he damages surrounding enemies for 200% of the Healing received, evenly split among them.
expired_skin_cream.name: Expired Skin Cream

explorer.description: When a Roster Dude takes damage below 30% HP, the Explorer Dude gives him a Sip from his Canteen to Heal him for 150% of his DPS. His Canteen can hold 2 sips and refills one sip every 3 seconds.
explorer.name: Explorer Dude

explosive_innards.description: When the Zombie Dude takes Direct Damage, he has a 0.5% chance to explode, dealing damage to surrounding enemies equal to 200% of his Max HP. This explosion Knocks Out the Zombie Dude.
explosive_innards.name: Explosive Innards

fairy_ring.description: Immediately grants 2 Strange Spores and reduces their price by 50%. All Dudes gain 100% Healing Received while under the effects of Strange Spores.
fairy_ring.name: Fairy Ring

fantasy.description: Fantasy Dudes use magic and otherworldly abilities to empower themselves and each other.
fantasy.name: Fantasy

farmer.description: The Farmer Dude has high natural Toughness. When he receives Healing from another Dude, he Donates 50% of the restored HP to the most-injured other Roster Dude instead of accepting it for himself.
farmer.name: Farmer Dude

finance.description: Each Finance Dude on your Team generates $3 at the end of each battle.
finance.name: Finance Dude

flaming_skull.description: The Skeledude burns for 10% of his Max HP every second, dealing damage to surrounding enemies for the same amount.
flaming_skull.name: Flaming Skull

frankendude.description: The Frankendude has high natural Regeneration. Every second, he Donates 10% of his current HP to the 2 most-injured Roster Dudes, split between them.
frankendude.name: Frankendude

frenzy_stone.description: When a Skeledude gets Summoned, all Dudes gain 1% Attack Speed for the rest of the battle, stacking up to 30%.
frenzy_stone.name: Frenzy Stone

fresh_sheets.description: All Dudes gain 10% Max HP. In addition, the Ghost Dude gains 10% Evasion, and he has a 20% chance to cast Phase Shift when he Evades.
fresh_sheets.name: Fresh Sheets

frilled_shoulderpads.description: The General Dude's Tactical Command now Heals for 20% of the target Dude's Max HP, and he gains that amount as Temporary Health for himself for 4 seconds. Overhealing on the target Dude converts to Temporary Health.
frilled_shoulderpads.name: Frilled Shoulderpads

general.description: Every 4 seconds, he commands a random Dude of the Dude Type immediately below him on the Roster to Taunt up to 3 nearby enemies.
general.name: General Dude

ghost.description: When he deals Direct Damage, he has a 30% chance to Equalize the HP between the most-injured Roster Dude and the healthiest Roster Dude. He then Heals them both for 100% of his Attack Power.
ghost.name: Ghost Dude

gold_star.description: When a General Dude uses Tactical Command, he applies 10% Crit Exposure to the Taunted enemies for 4 seconds.
gold_star.name: Gold Insignia

gravestone.description: When a Dude gets Knocked Out, his skeleton gets Summoned as a Skeledude and continues fighting for the rest of the battle.
gravestone.name: Gravestone

grog.description: Berserk now grants 100% Cleave and lasts 2 seconds longer.
grog.name: Grog

hachimaki.description: When a Samurai Dude lands a Direct Crit, there is a 20% chance for all Samurai Dudes to gain a stacking 5% Crit Damage for the rest of the battle.
hachimaki.name: Hachimaki

hacker.description: Every 4 seconds, each Hacker Dude gains an Exploit. When a Dude Attacks, his Exploits are consumed to deal 100% of his DPS each, combined into one Direct Damage strike.
hacker.name: Hacker Dude

half_full_glass.description: When a Dude takes damage that brings his HP below 50%, he Heals for 15% of his Max HP. 5 second Cooldown.
half_full_glass.name: Half-Full Glass

hand_sanitizer.description: The Medic Dude gains 20% Max HP. When he casts Triage, he gains Temporary Health for 2 seconds equal to 10% of his Max HP.
hand_sanitizer.name: Hand Sanitizer

haunted_mirror.description: The Ghost Dude grants 2% Regeneration to his Phase Shift targets for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
haunted_mirror.name: Haunted Mirror

health_potion.description: Heals half of your Roster Dudes for 50% of their Max HP, prioritizing those that are the most injured. Any Overhealing is converted to Temporary Health.
health_potion.name: Health Potion

helmet.description: When a Dude gets Thrown, he gains 100% Run Speed, 30% Attack Speed, and Temporary Health equal to 10% of his Max HP for 4 seconds.
helmet.name: Padded Helmet

hollow_fangs.description: The Vampire Dude gains 60% Attack Power and 50% Cleave.
hollow_fangs.name: Hollow Fangs

honk_blast.description: Emits a powerful quack, creating a traveling shockwave that Throws Dudes in its path.
honk_blast.name: Quack Blast

hpmax.description: How much damage you can take.
hpmax.name: Max HP

imposing_podium.description: When a General Dude uses Tactical Command, the target Dude gains an Independently Stacking 10% Toughness for 4 seconds.
imposing_podium.name: Imposing Podium

katana_sharpener.description: When the Samurai Dude arrives at his Dash target, he gains an Independently Stacking 20% Attack Power and 2% Crit Chance for 4 seconds.
katana_sharpener.name: Katana Sharpener

keep_calm_poster.description: When battle starts, all Dudes gain 30% Attack Power. This bonus decays by 3% each second until it runs out.
keep_calm_poster.name: Brass Knuckles

knight.description: Every 3 seconds, the Knight Dude Taunts 5 nearby enemies to focus their attacks on him.
knight.name: Knight Dude

knucklebones.description: When a Dude takes damage from an enemy's Cleave, he has a 25% chance to curse the attacker, applying 15% Cleave Damage Down for 4 seconds.
knucklebones.name: Knucklebones

leaky_heart_valve.description: The Frankendude gains 30% Max HP, and his Blood Pump grants 3% Toughness and 4% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
leaky_heart_valve.name: Leaky Heart Valve

leather_bracer.description: When the Spartan Dude uses Phalanx to Block for another Dude, he grants 5% Crit Chance for 2 seconds. This effect can stack up to 3 times.
leather_bracer.name: Leather Bracer

lich.description: 70% of his incoming damage gets Stored in his Thralls instead. Every 3 seconds, the Stored Damage is Expelled onto them as True Damage. If it is Fatal, the Thrall is Healed for 50% HP and gains a stack of Revenant.
lich.name: Lich Dude

lieutenant_sigil.description: The third Dude Type on your Roster gains 10% Crit Chance.
lieutenant_sigil.name: Lieutenant's Sigil

lifesteal.description: A chance when dealing Direct Damage to Heal yourself for an amount equal to the damage dealt.
lifesteal.name: Lifesteal

lightning_potion.description: Deals 1000 damage to enemies at random and Stuns them for 1 second. The damage is evenly split among enemies struck and increases each round.
lightning_potion.name: Bottled Lightning

living_hand.description: 2 Skeledudes are Summoned when battle starts, plus an additional Skeledude every 10 rounds.
living_hand.name: Living Hand

living_will.description: When any Dude gets Knocked Out, the 10 most-injured Roster Dudes are Healed for 20.
living_will.name: Living Will

loaded_dice.description: Immediately grants 2 Pocket Dice and reduces their price by 50%. Pocket Dice has a 50% chance to not be consumed when used.
loaded_dice.name: Loaded Dice

lokis_arm.description: Berserk grants an additional 50% Attack Speed. When the Viking Dude deals Direct Damage while Berserk, he gains a stacking 5% Attack Power that expires when Berserk ends.
lokis_arm.name: Loki's Arm

loyalty_card.description: Restocking the Merchant Dude's shop now costs $25 less, and the first Restock is always free.
loyalty_card.name: Loyalty Card

manager.description: When battle starts, the Manager Dude chooses 4 Non-Manager Dudes as Interns. He copies and Stores 15% of all damage they deal and Expels it onto his chosen Micromanage Target.
manager.name: Manager Dude

medic.description: The Medic Dude Heals the 3 most-injured Roster Dudes for 10 every time he deals a total of 50 damage.
medic.name: Medic Dude

medical_bag.description: If a Medic Dude is hit by damage for more than 15% of his Max HP and survives, he Heals himself for 50% of the damage taken.
medical_bag.name: Medical Bag

meteor.description: Calls down a meteor that deals 100 damage to all enemies in a location of your choosing, with its damage increasing each round. Dudes struck will be Thrown but unharmed.
meteor.name: Meteor

miss_chance.description: The chance that your damage fails to connect with a target. Miss Chance is a Diminishing Stat.
miss_chance.name: Miss Chance

mobius_strip.description: Immediately gain 2 Dude Juice. All consumables used during battle have a 30% chance to not be consumed.
mobius_strip.name: Mobius Strip

morphine.description: The Medic Dude's Triage has a 30% chance to apply Temporary Health for 3 seconds equal to 200% of the amount Healed.
morphine.name: Morphine

mummy.description: All Direct Damage he deals generates an equal amount of Doom that gets Stored on the target. When the target's HP drops below its Doom level, the curse triggers and Expels the damage onto the target.
mummy.name: Mummy Dude

mutant.description: His Direct Damage has a 50% chance to create a Floofball that Heals for 100% of his Attack Power. He attaches it to a Roster Dude in danger, and it bursts as needed. Dudes can have up to 4 Floofballs.
mutant.name: Mutant Dude

naginata.description: If the first Direct Damage a Samurai Dude deals after Dashing is a Critical Hit, he Heals for 50% of his Max HP, he instantly uses Swift Pursuit, and he gains a stacking 50% Run Speed for 5 seconds.
naginata.name: Naginata

necromancer.description: The Necrodude Summons a Skeledude when battle starts. When his Skeledude gets Knocked Out, the Necrodude Summons a new one after 6 seconds.
necromancer.name: Necrodude

necronomicon.description: The Cooldown of the Necrodude's Skeledude Summoner ability is reduced by 50%.
necronomicon.name: Necrodudicon

ninja.description: When the Ninja Dude lands a Direct Crit, he throws a Shuriken that bounces around, damaging 2 enemies for 50% of his Attack Power.
ninja.name: Ninja Dude

ninja_stars.description: For each Shuriken the Ninja Dude throws, he gains an Independently Stacking 1% Crit Chance for 1 second.
ninja_stars.name: Sharpened Stars

odin_statue.description: The Viking Dude automatically enters Berserk when he takes damage that drops his HP below 50% and again at 25%.
odin_statue.name: Odin Statue

organ_bucket.description: The Frankendude gains 100% Run Speed and 5% Regeneration. In addition, he gains 5% Attack Power during battle for each Unconscious Dude on your Team.
organ_bucket.name: Organ Bucket

organ_donor_list.description: The Frankendude's Blood Pump now Donates an additional 10% of his HP. When a Roster Dude takes Fatal Damage, the healthiest Frankendude with at least 30% HP will Donate 50% of his current HP to save him. 15 second Cooldown.
organ_donor_list.name: Organ Donor List

paladin.description: When battle starts, the Paladin Dude Blesses 2 random Roster Dudes. The Blessing reduces damage taken by 10% and Transfers 20% of the remaining damage to the Paladin Dude instead.
paladin.name: Paladin Dude

phantasm_crystal.description: The Ghost Dude grants 10% Evasion and 5% Lifesteal to his Phase Shift targets for 3 seconds.
phantasm_crystal.name: Phantasm Crystal

pirate.description: He Taunts 4 enemies for 3 seconds when battle starts. Every 5 seconds, he takes a drink of Rum to gain 20% Evasion for 3 seconds.
pirate.name: Pirate Dude

pocket_shuriken.description: The Ninja Dude throws 1 additional Shuriken.
pocket_shuriken.name: Pocket Shurikens

possessed_urn.description: The Ghost Dude casts Phase Shift every 3 seconds. When he casts Phase Shift, he gains an Independently Stacking 5% Attack Power for 3 seconds.
possessed_urn.name: Possessed Urn

psionic.description: He Taunts 5 enemies when battle starts. When he Deflects or takes Deflected Damage, he has a 5% chance to Taunt 2 nearby enemies for 3 seconds.
psionic.name: Psionic Dude

pumpkin_latte.description: Immediately grants 2 Health Potions and reduces their price by 50%. Health Potions now Heal all of your Roster Dudes and grant 20% Toughness for 5 seconds.
pumpkin_latte.name: Pumpkin Latte

purple_heart.description: When any Dude lands a Critical Hit, he gains Temporary Health for 2 seconds for 10% of his Max HP. 2 second Cooldown.
purple_heart.name: Purple Heart

quantum.description: Every 5 seconds he Summons an Echo Dude if he doesn't have one active. For each of his Echo Dudes, the Quantum Dude Heals the most-injured Roster Dude for 50% of his DPS every second.
quantum.name: Quantum Dude

r_ablative_shield.description: When the Knight Dude receives Healing, he gains Temporary Health equal to 100% of the Healing for 3 seconds.
r_ablative_shield.name: Ablative Shield

r_alchemy_table.description: Toxin can now stack 1 additional time. When the Assassin Dude deals Direct Damage, he also applies Toxin to another random enemy.
r_alchemy_table.name: Alchemy Table

r_ancient_idol.description: The Explorer Dude's Canteen now also grants 10% Block Chance for 5 seconds, stacking up to 2 times.
r_ancient_idol.name: Ancient Idol

r_andon_cord.description: When any Dude gets Knocked Out, all Dudes gain 90% Toughness for 2 seconds. Once per battle Global Cooldown.
r_andon_cord.name: Andon Cord

r_antifragility_implant.description: The Psionic Dude gains 30% Max HP. When a Psionic Dude takes Deflected Damage, he gains Temporary Health equal to 20% of his Max HP for 2 seconds. 1 second Cooldown.
r_antifragility_implant.name: Antifragility Implant

r_anubis_statue.description: When Curse of Doom gets applied to an enemy, it has a 15% chance to also Heal the most-injured Roster Dude for 100% of the amount applied.
r_anubis_statue.name: Anubis Statue

r_arcane_monocle.description: The Wizard Dude gains 50% Crit Damage. In addition, Dudes who get caught in a Fireball's blast radius gain 5% Attack Power for 4 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
r_arcane_monocle.name: Arcane Monocle

r_arsenal.description: All Dudes gain 5% Crit Chance and 20% Crit Damage.
r_arsenal.name: Arsenal

r_aspis.description: The Spartan Dude gains 15% Toughness, and his Phalanx gains an additional 10% chance to Block for other Spartan Dudes.
r_aspis.name: Aspis

r_bag_of_bones.description: Unconscious Thralls have a 50% chance to revive when entering the Ranch after battle. In addition, there is a 20% chance for a Skeledude to be Summoned when a Thrall gains a stack of Revenant.
r_bag_of_bones.name: Bag of Bones

r_bandage.description: When the Explorer Dude uses Canteen, he also uses a bandage to Heal the most-injured Roster Dude for the same amount.
r_bandage.name: Bandage

r_bandoleer.description: When a Dude arrives after being Lassoed, he damages up to 10 nearby enemies for 100% of his Max HP, split between them.
r_bandoleer.name: Bandoleer

r_barrel_of_oranges.description: The Pirate Dude gains 20% Max HP. When he lands a Critical Hit, he gains 5% Healing Received for the rest of the battle, stacking up to 5 times.
r_barrel_of_oranges.name: Barrel of Oranges

r_bass_drum.description: The Bard Dude's Four Chord Song inspires your Dudes to dance, granting 2% Evasion per stack.
r_bass_drum.name: Bass Drum

r_battle_hymn.description: The Paladin Dude's Blessing now grants 20% Attack Power and 30% Run Speed.
r_battle_hymn.name: Battle Hymn

r_beam_splitter.description: The Alien Dude's Tractor Beam now targets an additional Dude, and it applies Temporary Health equal to 10% of the target Dude's Max HP for 2 seconds.
r_beam_splitter.name: Beam Splitter

r_bear_arms.description: When the Druid Dude lands a Direct Crit while in Bear Form, he gains a stacking 5% Attack Power for the rest of the battle.
r_bear_arms.name: Bear Arms

r_bear_back.description: Bear Form now grants 20% Toughness, and the Druid Dude gains Temporary Health for 30% of his Max HP for 3 seconds when entering Bear Form.
r_bear_back.name: Bear Back

r_bear_down.description: When he takes Fatal Damage, the Druid Dude fully Heals, enters Bear Form, and Dashes to the farthest enemy, damaging enemies in his path for 50% of his DPS. 10 second Cooldown.
r_bear_down.name: Bear Down

r_bear_grill.description: Bear Form now grants an additional 20% Attack Power, 10% Crit Chance, and 10% Lifesteal.
r_bear_grill.name: Bear Grill

r_bear_hug.description: When he enters Bear Form, the Druid Dude lets out a roar that empowers nearby Dudes, granting 20% Attack Power and 10% Toughness for 3 seconds.
r_bear_hug.name: Bear Hug

r_boombox.description: The Construction Dude gains 30% Max HP and 20% Attack Speed.

r_oregano.description: The Chef Dude increases the effects of the Food Dude's meals by 100%, and his Burgers now grant 10% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

r_overactive_amygdala.description: When 20 of a Mutant Dude's Floofballs burst, he Dashes away, damaging enemies he passes through for 100% of his Attack Power, and he gains a stacking 10% Attack Power for the rest of the battle.

r_overcharged_amp.description: The Bard Dude's Four Chord Song deals damage for 200% of his DPS, split between 3 nearby enemies.

r_overclocked_servos.description: The Cyborg Dude gains 200% Run Speed and 30% Attack Power.

r_parrot.description: When a Dude Taunts, he damages the enemy for 50% of his Attack Power.

r_particle_accelerator.description: When a Time Dude attaches an Anomaly to a Dude, that Dude gains 20% Attack Speed and 20% Run Speed for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

r_peg_leg.description: The Pirate Dude gains 20% Max HP. When he Evades, he has a 10% chance to Taunt 2 nearby enemies for 3 seconds.

r_piano_wire.description: When an Asset takes damage, his Agent Dude has a 20% chance to retaliate, damaging the attacker for 200% of his DPS.

r_pitchfork.description: When the Farmer Dude deals Direct Damage, he gains a stacking 20% Cleave. When he reaches 20 stacks, the stacks reset and he Taunts 3 nearby enemies for 3 seconds.

r_plague_mask.name: Plague Mask

r_plot_armor.description: When a Dude takes damage, he has a 0.5% chance to gain 50% Attack Power and 90% Toughness for 2 seconds. Once per battle Cooldown.
r_plot_armor.name: Plot Armor

r_pneumatic_fist.description: When a Cyborg Dude deals Direct Damage to his Primary Target, he has a 25% chance to deal another 100% of his Attack Power as Direct Damage. Chained Effect.

r_pocket_flask.description: When the Pirate Dude takes Fatal Damage, he drinks Rum and fully Heals. 6 second Cooldown.
r_pocket_flask.name: Pocket Flask

r_pocket_obelisk.description: Every 5 seconds, the Warlock Dude teleports to a random Dude, Taunts up to 5 nearby enemies for 3 seconds, and grants 10% Crit Chance to all nearby Dudes for 3 seconds.

r_psychic_hood.description: When a Psionic Dude takes damage, he weakens the attacker's mind, causing them to lose 1% Attack Power and gain 1% Vulnerability for 2 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.

r_pyre.description: Cave Dude get 15% Toughness! Dude get Knocked Out? Each Cave Dude have 10% chance to Bunga!

r_quark_nugget.description: Every 5 seconds, for each of his active Echo Dudes, the Quantum Dude grants Temporary Health equal to 100% of his DPS to 2 random Roster Dudes for 5 seconds.

r_rad_infusion.description: Dudes affected by Tractor Beam gain 25% Attack Power and 5% Crit Chance for 2 seconds after arriving at their target, stacking up to 4 times.

r_rewinder.description: When a Time Dude takes Fatal Damage, his Anomalies detonate to deal 200% bonus damage, he fully Heals, and he teleports to where he was 1 second ago. 8 second Cooldown.

r_ring_of_shielding.description: 25% of all Overhealing now gets converted into Temporary Health that lasts for 2 seconds.

r_ruby_scepter.name: Ruby Scepter

r_vault.description: Grants a 15% chance to earn a 100% increased payout after winning a battle.

r_waffle_fries.description: Burgers now come with a side of Waffle Fries, granting the target Dude 5% Attack Power for 4 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

ranger.description: When he deals Direct Damage, he has a 25% chance to fire a Magic Arrow at a distant enemy for 100% of his Attack Power.

regeneration.description: Every second, you will passively Heal for this percentage of your Max HP.

ritual_dagger.description: All Dudes gain 2% Regeneration. When a Dude Heals through Regeneration, he has a 20% chance to throw a dagger at a random enemy for 100% of his DPS as Direct Damage.

rotting_steak.description: All Dudes gain 10% Attack Speed and 30% Run Speed.

t_knife.description: The creature has a knife, so it gains 15% Piercing.

t_proud.description: When a Lion or Lioness is defeated, all Lions gain an Independently Stacking 10% Attack Power for 10 seconds.

talking_head.description: The Zombie Dude gains 20% Max HP and 4% Regeneration.
talking_head.name: Shrunken Head

tattered_shoes.description: All Dudes gain 5% Run Speed and 2% Max HP for each Zombie Dude on your Team. This effect stacks up to 5 times.
tattered_shoes.name: Tattered Shoes

taunt_resistance.description: The chance to ignore a Taunt.
taunt_resistance.name: Taunt Resistance

time.description: Every 4 seconds, he attaches 2 Time Anomalies to the Dudes next to him on the Roster. The Time Anomalies detonate after 3 seconds.
time.name: Time Dude

tosei_gusoku.description: When the Samurai Dude reaches his Dash target, he gains Temporary Health equal to 30% of his Max HP for 4 seconds.
tosei_gusoku.name: Tosei Gusoku

toughness.description: Reduces all incoming damage. Toughness is a Diminishing Stat.
toughness.name: Toughness

tourniquet.description: When a Medic Dude takes damage that drops his HP below 30%, all Medic Dudes gain 30% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.
tourniquet.name: Tourniquet

tower_shield.description: The Spartan Dude's Phalanx gains a 10% increased chance to Block for other Dudes.
tower_shield.name: Tower Shield

tr_bad_credit.description: 50% of the Wielder's incoming damage gets Stored and spread out over 4 seconds. Every second, he has a 50% chance to Expel 50% of the Stored Damage onto the Best Fit enemy as Direct Damage.
tr_bad_credit.name: Bad Credit

tr_bag_of_nuts.description: The Wielder has a 5% chance when dealing Direct Damage to go nuts, gaining 50% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.
tr_bag_of_nuts.name: Bag of Nuts

tr_bongos.description: Every second, the Wielder alternates between gaining 20% Evasion and 20% Deflection.
tr_bongos.name: Bongos

tr_crazy_straw.description: The Wielder gains 10% Lifesteal. When he Lifesteals, he gains 5% Crit Chance for 3 seconds, stacking up to 2 times.
tr_crazy_straw.name: Crazy Straw

tr_fedora.description: The Wielder gains 3% Attack Power and 1% Max HP multiplied by the difference between the count of the most prevalent Dude Type on the Roster and the Wielder's Dude Type.
tr_fedora.name: Fedora

tr_folding_chair.description: When the Wielder deals Attack Damage, he has a 20% chance to strike again for 30% of his Max HP as Direct Damage.
tr_folding_chair.name: Folding Chair

tr_friendship_bracelet.description: When the Wielder takes Fatal Damage, he survives by Equalizing his HP with the Dude who has the highest HP. This has a 2 second Cooldown.
tr_friendship_bracelet.name: Friendship Bracelet

tr_glass_cannon.description: When the Wielder lands a Critical Hit, he gains a stacking 5% Attack Power and 1% Vulnerability for the rest of the battle.
tr_glass_cannon.name: Glass Cannon

tr_grudge_bangle.description: When the Wielder takes Fatal Damage, he fully Heals and gains 30% Attack Power for the rest of the battle. Once per battle Cooldown.
tr_grudge_bangle.name: Ear Gauges

tr_kinetic_shield.description: Every 3 seconds, the Wielder strikes the nearest 4 enemies, dealing Direct Damage equal to 25% of his DPS to each. This damage always Crits.
tr_kinetic_shield.name: Baseball Bat

tr_laser_pointer.description: Every second, each Wielder has a 20% chance to teleport a random Dude of the Dude Type below him on the Roster to a random distant Dude or enemy and grant him 20% Attack Speed for 2 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
tr_laser_pointer.name: Laser Pointer

tr_medical_license.description: For every 100 damage the Wielder deals, he Heals a random injured Roster Dude for 15.
tr_medical_license.name: Medical License

tr_neckbrace.description: The Wielder gains 20% Max HP. When he takes damage that drops him below 30% HP, he gains Temporary Health for 50% of his Max HP for 4 seconds. 4 second Cooldown.
tr_neckbrace.name: Neckbrace

tr_overcharged_battery.description: The Diss Track copies 30% of damage dealt by all of its Wielders and Stores it. Every second, the Stored damage is Expelled onto the Best Fit enemy.
tr_overcharged_battery.name: Diss Track

tr_peace_pipe.description: Every 2 seconds, the Wielder grants Temporary Health for 25% of his Max HP to a random injured Roster Dude for 3 seconds.
tr_peace_pipe.name: Socialism

tr_pet_rock.description: The Wielder gains 10% Block Chance. When he Blocks, he gains 10% Crit Chance and 20% Crit Damage for 2 seconds.
tr_pet_rock.name: Pet Rock

tr_rage_alarm.description: Every second, the Wielder gains 5% Attack Power and 5% Run Speed that lasts for the rest of the battle, stacking up to 10 times.
tr_rage_alarm.name: Airhorn

tr_receipts.description: When the Wielder lands a Direct Crit, he has a 50% chance to Taunt 2 nearby enemies and gain 10% Toughness and 5% Lifesteal for 4 seconds, stacking up to 2 times.
tr_receipts.name: Receipts

tr_rizz.description: Dudes adjacent to the Wielder on the Roster gain 1% Crit Chance and 1% Evasion for every 2 Wielders, stacking up to 10 times.
tr_rizz.name: Rizz

tr_rocket_pants.description: The Wielder gains 40% Run Speed. Every 4 seconds, he Dashes to the farthest enemy from himself.
tr_rocket_pants.name: ADHD

tr_scrubs.description: The Wielder gains 20% Deflection. When he Deflects, he has a 20% chance to gain 30% Attack Power for 2 seconds.
tr_scrubs.name: Scrubs

tr_shock_boots.description: For every 50 feet traveled, the Wielder shocks a nearby enemy for 50% of his DPS.
tr_shock_boots.name: Taser

tr_shovel.description: The Wielder gains a stacking 20% Cleave during battle for every Unconscious Dude on your Team.
tr_shovel.name: Shovel

tr_smart_medicine.description: When the Wielder Heals any target, he has a chance equal to his Crit Chance to also Heal the most-injured Roster Dude for the same amount.
tr_smart_medicine.name: Inhaler

tr_smoke_cloak.description: The Wielder gains 10% Crit Chance and 15% Attack Power and can no longer be Cleaved.
tr_smoke_cloak.name: Ghillie Suit

tr_tank_treads.description: For every 25 feet the Wielder travels, he gains a stacking 1% Attack Power for the rest of the battle.
tr_tank_treads.name: Cutoff Jorts

tr_therapy.description: While the Wielder is above 70% HP he gains 30% Toughness. This benefit decreases to 10% Toughness as his HP approaches 20%.
tr_therapy.name: Therapy

tr_twisted_statue.description: The Wielder gains 30% Toughness and 30% Attack Power but loses 50% Run Speed.
tr_twisted_statue.name: Weighted Vest

tr_vampiric_tattoo.description: The Wielder gains 10% Deflection, and all Deflected Damage now gets redirected to him. When he takes Deflected Damage, he gains 5% Toughness for 4 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
tr_vampiric_tattoo.name: Face Tattoo

tr_wind_totem.description: The Wielder gains 10% Evasion. When he Evades, he has a 20% chance to strike back, dealing Direct Damage equal to 100% of his DPS.
tr_wind_totem.name: Black Belt

tr_wrist_blade.description: When the Wielder deals Attack Damage, he has a chance equal to the target's missing HP Percentage to strike again, dealing Direct Damage equal to 60% of his Attack Power.
tr_wrist_blade.name: Shiv

trait_apes_together.description: Gains a stacking 1% Attack Power for every Gorilla type enemy active in the battle.
trait_apes_together.name: Apes Together Strong

trait_backhand.description: Its Attacks have a 25% chance to Throw its Primary Target an extreme distance.
trait_backhand.name: Backhand

trait_cavitation_bubble.description: Its Attacks have a 5% chance to cause an explosion that Throws all nearby Dudes.
trait_cavitation_bubble.name: Cavitation Bubble

trait_charger.description: The creature will sometimes charge across the battlefield, damaging Dudes it passes through and Throwing them.
trait_charger.name: Charger

trait_mudslinger.description: Its Attacks have a 30% chance to fling mud at a random Dude. All Dudes near the mud's impact area gain 15% Miss Chance for 2 seconds.
trait_mudslinger.name: Mudslinger

trait_peck.description: The creature's Attack Damage has a 10% chance to apply 10% Miss Chance to its target for 2 seconds.
trait_peck.name: Peck

trait_pinch.description: When the creature deals Attack Damage, it has a 10% chance to latch onto its target for 3 seconds. While latched, it damages the target for 75% of its DPS every half-second.
trait_pinch.name: Pinch

trait_plagued.description: Its Attacks spread the Plague, reducing its target's Healing Received by 1% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
trait_plagued.name: Plagued

trait_quills.description: The creature gains 10% Piercing, and it has a 15% chance when receiving Attack Damage to deal damage to the attacker for 30% of its DPS.
trait_quills.name: Quills

trait_slashing_rampage.description: When its HP drops below 50%, it Dashes rapidly between 5 random Dudes, slashing them for 60% of its DPS.
trait_slashing_rampage.name: Slashing Rampage

trait_snap.description: The creature's Attack Damage removes fingers, reducing its target's Attack Power by 1% for the rest of the battle, stacking up to 10 times.
trait_snap.name: Snap

trait_stable.description: Its low center of gravity prevents it from being Thrown or Stunned.
trait_stable.name: Stable

trait_tripod.description: Its tail makes it so stable that it cannot be Thrown or Stunned.
trait_tripod.name: Tripod

trait_venom.description: The creature's Attack Damage applies 1% Vulnerability to its target for the rest of the battle, stacking up to 10 times.
trait_venom.name: Venom

trooper.description: When battle starts and every 10 seconds, he calls down an Orbital Strike on a random enemy, damaging all enemies caught in the blast for 100% of his DPS.
trooper.name: Trooper Dude

turbo_team.description: The Ninja Dude gains 20% Max HP. When he uses Shuriken Throw, nearby Dudes gain 5% Attack Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.
turbo_team.name: Turbo Team

undead.description: Undead Dudes thrive in chaos and are completely unbothered when their fellow Dudes fall in combat.
undead.name: Undead

unit_tattoo.description: When the Spartan Dude uses Phalanx to Block for another Dude, he has a 30% chance to grant Temporary Health equal to 10% of his Max HP for 3 seconds.
unit_tattoo.name: Unit Tattoo

vampire.description: When the Vampire Dude Lifesteals, he applies his Bloodsucker Aura to 2 random Roster Dudes, granting 2% Lifesteal for 4 seconds. This effect stacks up to 4 times.
vampire.name: Vampire Dude

venomous_lipstick.description: The Vampire Dude gains 30% Attack Power, and his Direct Damage reduces enemy Attack Power by 2% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
venomous_lipstick.name: Venomous Lipstick

viking.description: When the Viking Dude deals Direct Damage to an enemy, he has a 5% chance to go Berserk, gaining 50% Attack Speed and Run Speed for 3 seconds.
viking.name: Viking Dude

wakizashi.description: The Samurai Dude gains 50% Cleave. When he lands a Direct Crit, he gains a stacking 2% Attack Power for the rest of the battle.
wakizashi.name: Wakizashi

warhorn.description: The Viking Dude gains 10% Attack Power. In addition, when any Dude goes Berserk, there is a 30% chance for another Dude to also go Berserk. Chained Effect.
warhorn.name: Warhorn

warlock.description: The Warlock Dude has made a Pact with an evil being, slowing his incoming damage. His Direct Damage has a 25% chance to Expel 20% of the damage Stored in his Pact onto his target and Taunt it for 3 seconds.
warlock.name: Warlock Dude

warrior.description: Warrior Dudes use precision and coordinated attacks to work together and outsmart their opponents.
warrior.name: Warrior

western.description: Every 3 seconds, the Cowboy Dude Lassoes a Roster Dude and forces him to Dash to his side, prioritizing Dudes who are farther away.
western.name: Cowboy Dude

willing_flesh.description: The Zombie Dude gains 15% Healing Received. When any Zombie Dude gets Knocked Out, there is a 5% chance that all Unconscious Zombie Dudes instantly revive with full HP. 4 second Global Cooldown.
willing_flesh.name: Willing Flesh

winged_shoes.description: When a Dude takes damage that drops his HP below 30%, he gains 100% Cleave for 3 seconds.
winged_shoes.name: Rage Bait

wizard.description: The Wizard Dude casts a Fireball every 3 seconds at a random enemy, dealing damage equal to 50% of his DPS to all enemies in the blast area.
wizard.name: Wizard Dude

wolfskin_cloak.description: The Viking Dude gains 20% Max HP, and Berserk grants 20% Toughness.
wolfskin_cloak.name: Wolfskin Cloak

zombie.description: When he receives Healing, he has a 15% chance to Taunt 3 nearby enemies for 3 seconds. Zombie Dudes recover from being Unconscious after only 1 round.
zombie.name: Zombie Dude
